labels: enhancement, triage

## Feature Description

A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see added.

## Problem or Motivation

Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.

A clear and concise description of what the problem is. Example: "I'm always
frustrated when [...]"

## Proposed Solution

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## Alternatives Considered

A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've
considered.

## No AI Compliance

FED TTS follows a strict "No AI" philosophy. We do not use neural networks,
cloud APIs, LLMs, or generative AI. All features must work using deterministic
algorithms.

- [ ] This feature can be implemented with deterministic algorithms (regex, dictionaries, rules)
- [ ] This feature does not require cloud APIs or internet connectivity
- [ ] This feature does not require neural networks or ML models

If your feature requires AI, please explain how it could be adapted to work
without AI, or note that it is out of scope.

## Additional Context

Add any other context, screenshots, or examples about the feature request here.

## Implementation Ideas (Optional)

If you have ideas on how this could be implemented (code snippets, libraries,
algorithms), share them here.
